_comment: skip_files lists paths that are not shipped library code. The mix tasks under lib/mix are excluded from the Hex package (see :exclude_patterns in mix.exs), and test/support only exists so tests can compile — counting either one measures how well the test harness tests itself.
_ratchet: Set just below the current real figure so coverage can never regress. Raise it whenever a phase lifts the number; the target is 90. History: 77.1 -> 84.2 (facade collapse, i18n and facade sweeps) -> 86.9 (v0.3.0 additions).
